d: Astronomers find signs of a new, hidden planet which lies in our solar system beyond Neptune. The new study points to the existence of a planet which has 1.5 to 2 times the mass of the Earth. Firstpost takes a closer look at the new study, and explains what this means for our solar system. Hem Kaur Saroya explains how far the new planet, PX2, is likely to be from the Earth and the Sun. HKS also looks at how this compares to the discovery of other planets like Neptune, and dwarf planets like Pluto.
